## Review checklist

- [ ] Work was developed on a non-default branch.
- [ ] The pull request has one reviewable purpose.
- [ ] Relevant tests and validation passed.
- [ ] No credentials, private material, or machine-specific audit output is included.
- [ ] Documentation and catalogs match the implementation.
- [ ] An independent reviewer or repository owner approved the change.
